plain: Card has a new row slot (Card.Row, Card.RowTitle, Card.RowNote) that renders a StatusTile's content, and StatusTile is deprecated but still works.

steps.plain: StatusTile still works until 1.0.0; replace it with <Card padding="item"><Card.Row trailing={trailing}><Card.RowTitle>{title}</Card.RowTitle> plus one <Card.RowNote> per note, and drop tone, which StatusTile never painted.
